company.name: Arylla
company.shortDescription: Arylla is a company focused on making counterfeit goods a thing of the past.
company.description:
Arylla is a company focused on making counterfeit goods a thing of the past.

Arylla uses invisible ink to help resellers of luxury goods verify authenticity. Luxury brands partner with Arylla to apply the ink during production in exchange for a share of the revenue. Arylla is the first platform that enables luxury brands to monetize the resale of their products while fighting to reduce the number of counterfeits being sold online.

productsAndServices.description: A nanotechnology-based ink that is invisible and can be applied to various fashion products for authentication and traceability.
productsAndServices.name: Arylla Invisible Ink

productsAndServices.description: The invisible ink can be printed on a wide range of materials including labels, packaging, and trims.
productsAndServices.name: Many Label Applications

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables various departments to authenticate products, helping to prevent counterfeits and verify returns.
productsAndServices.name: Authentication

productsAndServices.description: Provides visibility across all channels, enabling tracking of products through each step of their lifecycle and offering real-time updates to customers.
